name: @datafog/wasm
description: Fast structured PII detection for browsers, powered by Rust and WebAssembly

scripts.build: cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir dist --out-name datafog_wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/datafog_wasm.wasm
